notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
We've been busy! Big things in the horizon for the Dark Union, however we couldn't move on without giving Tank Authority Wolfram a little more love. This update has two additions: A new weapon and a new enemy.

The weapon: 120-mm Mortar
Rain fury onto your enemies from above! Just make sure you actually have clear space above you to fire...
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44921658/a4df4079620777b57763a8266f65673309fec3e4.gif

The enemy: The AT Barrier Drones
Two drones that charge a barrier that once deployed deals massive damage! Make sure to shoot them down before they charge...
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44921658/f46fcf14c3916f3074392b43172fcc6f40008128.gif

Hope you guys enjoy the new additions!

notes.title: Update: User music
notes.notes:
This update automatically creates a folder for players to put music in for it to be played in-game. This folder can be found at the same folder as the game executable (steamapps/common/tank-authority-wolfram).

To use this feature, navigate to the games folder and place your music files inside of the "usermusic" folder. Supported formats are WAV, MP3 and OGG.
